@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Before the flight took off, the p______rs were asked to turn off their electronic devices or put them in airplane mode.
= passengers
~詞義 passenger（n.）乘客
~原文 Before the flight took off, the passengers were asked to turn off their electronic devices or put them in airplane mode.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Regular exercise and balanced meals helped Ken maintain a s______m and healthy body.
= slim
~詞義 slim（adj.）苗條纖細的
~原文 Regular exercise and balanced meals helped Ken maintain a slim and healthy body.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: After watching the h______r movie, Jill couldn't sleep alone that night.
= horror
~詞義 horror（n.）恐怖
~原文 After watching the horror movie, Jill couldn't sleep alone that night.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The reasons behind feelings of ______ (jealous) are often insecurity, low self-esteem, and greed.
= jealousy
~詞義 jealousy（n.）嫉妒
~原文 The reasons behind feelings of jealousy are often insecurity, low self-esteem, and greed.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The classroom has been painted in bright colors in order to create a ______ (cheer) learning atmosphere.
= cheerful
~詞義 cheerful（adj.）快樂的
~原文 The classroom has been painted in bright colors in order to create a cheerful learning atmosphere.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Don't ______ to ask your parents if you need help with your homework.
A: confirm
B: explode
C: hesitate
D: invent
= C
~詞義 hesitate（v.）猶豫
~原文 Don't hesitate to ask your parents if you need help with your homework.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The ______ of trains has benefitted people a lot by saving them considerable time when traveling long distances.
A: dinosaur
B: explosion
C: invention
D: hesitation
= C
~詞義 invention（n.）發明
~原文 The invention of trains has benefitted people a lot by saving them considerable time when traveling long distances.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The athlete ______ taking any drugs, claiming that a mistake must have been made in the test results.
A: denied
B: invented
C: exploded
D: horrified
= A
~詞義 deny（v.）否認
~原文 The athlete denied taking any drugs, claiming that a mistake must have been made in the test results.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Psychologists argue that personality is developed through the ______ interactions of a person with his or her environment and the people in it.
A: skinny
B: fearful
C: hesitant
D: ongoing
= D
~詞義 ongoing（adj.）不間斷的
~原文 Psychologists argue that personality is developed through the ongoing interactions of a person with his or her environment and the people in it.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Words can be used to inspire others, but they can also be used like ______ and cause harm.
A: onions
B: weapons
C: towers
D: garages
= B
~詞義 weapon（n.）武器
~原文 Words can be used to inspire others, but they can also be used like weapons and cause harm.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: flash
B: elevators
C: floods
D: inventor
E: hesitant
F: missing

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Thomas Edison was a great ______ who introduced the electric light bulb to the world.
= D
~詞義 inventor（n.）發明家
~原文 Thomas Edison was a great inventor who introduced the electric light bulb to the world.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Despite the convenience of ______, they require regular maintenance by trained professionals.
= B
~詞義 elevator（n.）電梯
~原文 Despite the convenience of elevators, they require regular maintenance by trained professionals.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: It was a relief for the girl to find out that her ______ ID card had been found.
= F
~詞義 missing（adj.）遺失的
~原文 It was a relief for the girl to find out that her missing ID card had been found.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: The most common natural disasters in Taiwan are ______, mudslides, and earthquakes.
= C
~詞義 flood（n.）水災
~原文 The most common natural disasters in Taiwan are floods, mudslides, and earthquakes.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The memory of her childhood came back in a(n) ______ when Nancy smelled her grandmother's cooking.
= A
~詞義 flash（n.）瞬間;即刻(in a flash)
~原文 The memory of her childhood came back in a(n) flash when Nancy smelled her grandmother's cooking.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: semester
B: hesitation
C: quit
D: skinny
E: talkative
F: cropped

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: As soon as the firefighters received the phone call, they rushed to the fire scene without ______.
= B
~詞義 hesitation（n.）猶豫
~原文 As soon as the firefighters received the phone call, they rushed to the fire scene without hesitation.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The editor ______ the unnecessary details from the image to make it more focused and professional.
= F
~詞義 crop（v.）裁剪
~原文 The editor cropped the unnecessary details from the image to make it more focused and professional.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: This ______, Joanna is taking a course on modern American novels.
= A
~詞義 semester（n.）學期
~原文 This semester, Joanna is taking a course on modern American novels.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Only a really ______ person could fit between the extremely narrow alley between the two walls.
= D
~詞義 skinny（adj.）非常瘦的
~原文 Only a really skinny person could fit between the extremely narrow alley between the two walls.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: It's not easy for a person to ______ smoking; doing so requires determination and patience.
= C
~詞義 quit（v.）停止;放棄
~原文 It's not easy for a person to quit smoking; doing so requires determination and patience.
